svg.aria-label: TomlBeef parsing throughput compared with other TOML libraries
svg.text: geometric mean over 10 inputs of each library's MB/s ÷ TomlBeef's · higher is better · TomlBeef = 1×
* glaze failed config (mixed) and dates (no date/time in its schema-less mode; left out of its average).
* toml-span failed config (mixed) and dates (no date/time support; left out of its average).
* jtoml did not finish config (mixed) within 60 s (counted at that bound, which flatters it).
* tomlj did not finish comments only within 60 s (counted at that bound, which flatters it).
TomlBeef against the fastest alternative, per input
MB/s · for each input, the fastest other library that parsed it · bars scaled per input
ns per root[table][key] lookup, lower is better · 100,000 random lookups · log scale · same values found by every library
toml-spanner scans a table's entries on every lookup; the others use a hash map (TomlBeef, toml_edit) or a B-tree (toml).
Validation differs: zig-toml accepts invalid TOML (duplicate keys, invalid dates, control characters, bad UTF-8); glaze and toml-c skip UTF-8 checks.
